### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S-Section]: Ground all subjective details (e.g., demographics, symptom context, history) strictly to explicit patient statements in the transcript. Do not infer or add details (e.g., age, specific causal links for symptoms) not directly stated by the patient. Avoid placing objective diagnostic classifications (e.g., 'moderate' severity) in the Subjective section unless the patient explicitly states it as part of their history.
